evaluation: exploratory retrospective source flags applied uniformly to positive operator-incident pairs with available Cloudflare NetFlows captures; rule was not preregistered before inspecting source results
positive_label_scope: 15 affected operator-event pairs across eight timed incident cases; source-reference independence varies by row
x_label_scope: 32 operator-case searches: 15 positive and 17 NO_CONTROL windows; bounded query recovered 2 isolated explicit complaint authors in positive pairs and 0 in controls; 0 same-district/15m clusters at >=2 authors

rules.netflows: normalized incident-window median below same-weekday/time prior-week comparison median; exploratory, uncalibrated
rules.ioda: at least one IODA event onset within exact reference query window
rules.radar: matching outage annotation onset in exact query window
rules.x_geo: at least 2 distinct authors with explicit internet complaints in same unambiguous district and same 15-minute UTC bin
rules.technical_or: OR of NetFlows, IODA, Radar flags
rules.all_sources_or: OR of NetFlows, IODA, Radar and X geo-cluster flags
rules.two_families: at least two source-family flags in the same operator-event pair

counts.false_positive_rate: NOT_ESTIMABLE_FOR_DETECTOR; no independent normal windows. X-only NO_CONTROL sample was 0/17 but is bounded and not a population FPR.
counts.precision: NOT_ESTIMABLE; the 15 cases are selected positive references and there are no independently sampled negatives for the full system
counts.operational_freshness: NOT_ESTIMABLE; historical aggregate captures do not measure first detector time

limitations: The NetFlows direction rule and X cluster thresholds are exploratory and were not frozen before reviewing the evidence.
Prior-week NetFlows control is not independently labeled normal; a decrease is not an outage or percent traffic loss.
Only the X search mode to:operator filter:replies was aligned historically; other social modalities were sampled recently and cannot be scored on these case windows.
X had isolated complaint authors in two positive pairs but zero same-district/15m clusters at thresholds 2 or 3; no area-level social confirmation was found.
One case had no reliable start time and was not included in the 15 positive pairs.
No district/product attribution from the network signals; 11/15 references combine fixed and mobile.
No general false-positive, precision, recall, or first-detection freshness metric without independent negative windows and prospective captures.
Source-family independence is not fully established; Radar and NetFlows share Cloudflare as provider.
